newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Carmen Lawrence granted bail by Perth court.
newsitem.headline: Carmen Lawrence granted bail by Perth court.

text.p: Former West Australian Premier and sitting federal member for Fremantle, Carmen Lawrence, on Friday made her first court appearance on three charges of knowingly giving false evidence to the 1995 Marks Royal commission.
Through her lawyer Jim Mazza she pleaded not quilty and was remanded on bail of $5,000 to appear again on July 21.
The Marks Royal Commission was set up to examine the circumstances surrounding the tabling of a petition in the WA parliament in 1992 when Lawrence was Premier.

The petition contained allegations that were subsequently found to be misleading about a Perth lawyer Penny Easton and then opposition leader Richard Court. Four days after the petition was tabled Easton committed sucide.
The Royal Commission report handed down in late 1995 was critical of evidence given by Lawrence regarding her involvement in the so-called Easton affair.
Lawrence stood down earlier this week as shadow spokeswoman on the environment but has said she will not resign from national parliament.
